provenance.disputed_measurement: M4 PR 8a review MIN-3 measured every row 90-94% lower on the same workstation (e.g. die full 985.9 ms vs the ~14-17 s recorded here) and concluded this baseline was taken under contention. NOT REPRODUCIBLE under the conditions above: two independent quiet refreshes (2026-07-25 and 2026-07-26) agree within +/-20%. A ~14x gap is the documented opt-0-vs-opt-2 factor for this workspace, so the likely explanation is a differently-optimised build (RUSTFLAGS / CARGO_PROFILE_* / a shared target dir), not machine load. Treat cross-environment comparisons of the absolute numbers as meaningless - see 'portability'.
provenance.epsilon: CAD_TOLERANCE_EPS unset (the bootstrap default) - the row is ambient-eps agnostic by design.
provenance.load_conditions: Refreshed with ZERO other cargo build/test lanes running (pgrep verified immediately before AND after the run), RUSTFLAGS unset, no CARGO_PROFILE_* overrides; the only rustflag in effect is the committed x86-64-v3 CPU floor in .cargo/config.toml.
provenance.machine: developer workstation (WSL2, 8 cores, ~9 GB RAM) shared with other agent build lanes.
provenance.method: median of 3 runs in one process, std::time::Instant, sequential evaluation schedule (EvalOptions::default()).
provenance.portability: BOX-RELATIVE. Absolute milliseconds do not transfer between machines or load states; only the SHAPE is the signal (relative cost per document, and the full-vs-incremental ratio). Expect large +/-% on the first hosted-CI run and re-refresh from CI when hosted Actions returns.
provenance.profile: cargo test dev profile: opt-level 0 for the kernel crates, opt-level 2 only for spade and mesh (root Cargo.toml). NOT release-representative.
provenance.status: REPORTING ONLY - measured, never gated (M4-PLAN F8; PERF-PLAN stays advisory). No CI row fails on these numbers.
